value.0: The Revanite quartermaster has always had a bit of a charmed life, and considering his foppish attitude, it is ever something of a mystery how he rose to his position. Still, he has a magical touch when it comes to making the most out of limited resources, and his knack of always having a little extra - be it ammunition, crates of plasteel, or even a spare shuttle, once - cemented his place in managing the Revanite Orders' logistics. Even other Sith are careful of offending him, because rumor goes that if he perishes, the Revanite Order would go bankrupt the next day.
